title: Jewelry Store Franchise Opportunity
name: GAHANE, 3 Franchisees, Est'd in 2012, Kolkata HQ
description: Gahane is a Bengal heritage jewellery brand that offers affordable luxury. Gahane is a differentiated jewellery brand built on the authentic craftsmanship of Bengal. We design and manufacture handcrafted 925-certified silver jewellery with rich gold-polish finishes, delivering substantial, heritage-inspired pieces at accessible price points. The brand occupies a clear market position: "affordable luxury". Customers receive the look, weight, and traditional aesthetic of fine jewellery without the premium associated with solid gold — a proposition that resonates strongly during festivals, weddings, and gifting occasions such as Durga Puja and Dhanteras. Core strengths for investors: - Own manufacturing for tighter quality control, faster replenishment, and healthier margins. - 925 Hallmarked silver with lifetime plating warranty and assured buyback & exchange — building customer trust and repeat purchases. - Proven festive demand cycle in West Bengal and expanding North East markets. - Existing operational stores in Jodhpur Park and Salt Lake City Centre, with further expansion underway. Gahane offers two structured franchise models designed for different investor profiles: - FOCO (company operated) – Passive model with company-managed operations, 12% revenue share, 18% ROI minimum guarantee, and projected ROI of 23–36% over five years. - FOFO (franchisee-operated) – Higher-involvement model with 30% margin, same minimum guarantee, and projected ROI of 25–49% over five years. Both models feature a ₹50 lakh total investment (including ₹35 lakh refundable inventory), full training, marketing support, visual merchandising, and access to channel partner finance. Gahane combines a culturally rooted product, a scalable retail format, and a transparent financial structure — creating a compelling opportunity for partners seeking exposure to India’s growing organised jewellery market with controlled risk and clear upside. The franchise partner will need a GST registration.
